statements.status_notes: DHI Node packages reset bundled zlib's input state after direct-buffer gzwrite errors, preventing stale caller-owned pointers from reaching gzprintf or gzvprintf. Node 24 and 26 apply upstream zlib commit https://github.com/madler/zlib/commit/df84af25dc1942490e1d1c899a07619152a46148 directly; Node 22 applies the equivalent reset in its older zlib 1.3.1 error branch.
